label: Burst Window (s, 0 = off)
help: Alerts of the same kind stack into one burst while it is on screen, or when they arrive this close together. A burst plays the sound once. Cheers, raids, Super Chats, Super Stickers and Kicks always play on their own. 0 shows every alert on its own.

label: Burst Card Time (s)
help: How long each card in a burst stays in front before the next one replaces it. The last card stays for the full Alert Duration. Large bursts speed up to finish within about 8 seconds more than that.

label: Sub message
help: Used for subs, resubs and gift subs. Variables: {name}, {tier}, {months} (resubs), {count} (subs gifted), {message} (resub message).

label: Cheer message
help: Variables: {name}, {amountText} (with its unit, e.g. 1,000 bits), {amount} (the number alone), {message}.

label: Raid message
help: Variables: {name}, {amountText} (with its unit, e.g. 12 viewers), {amount} (the number alone).

label: Super Chat message
help: Variables: {name}, {amount} (with its currency, e.g. $5.00), {currency} (code, e.g. USD), {message}.

label: Kicks message
help: Variables: {name}, {amountText} (with its unit, e.g. 500 Kicks), {amount} (the number alone), {tier} (the gift's name, e.g. Rage Quit), {message}.

label: Burst overflow message
help: The last card of a burst too big to show one card per alert. Variables: {count} (alerts not shown).
